full_page.content:
1947, August 28
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
Mr. Joseph J. O'Donnell. 1120 Lake Shore Drive Chicago 11, Illinois.
August 28, 1947 Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap. Ser. Mass Assoc'n Huntington, Ind.
God made me to know Him. O what a bles'd aim! To love Him and serve Him sure rests in the same. It's Heaven begun for the grateful on earth. To treasure aright !-?-!
Highest Heaven its worth. - God himself - even here.
August 28 - Feast of St. Augustine - 1947.
God bless you Joseph J. O'Donnell - you and yours. I hope this finds all 100% yourselves in the grace of God - smiling after the wonderful rain He sent us, like lillies and roses.
I started these cards several days ago but some how or other they are later than intended and far from what I wanted. However, the little German saying "Nichts ..- " consoles me: "Nothing perfect in this world." In other words, no one is here on this side of Heaven fully converted.
Thank the good God, He has infinite patience ! - Adored be his Holy Name! Sincerely in the Sacred Hearts - Jesus - Mary Fr. Solanus, O.F.M. Cap.
